notes: A Stumble Guys-style last-player-standing round with a waiting lobby is the Minigame preset almost verbatim, so Party & Casual leads. Obby & Platformer is named second and doing real work: the map's entire content is moving contact-lethal obstacles the player jumps over under their own control, and hazard-kill and obstacle-moving are the only rows anywhere that express the travelling lasers — Obby's genre-wide P6 does not follow it into a mix it does not lead. The prompt states a lobby players wait in before the match starts, so I kept the preset's space-staged and its P4 rather than overriding it; the author never said one continuous surface, and silence is not a contradiction, though lobby-and-arena on one map would drop this to P0 if they want it sooner. Deciding without a user: I kept the preset's leaderboard wall since nothing contradicts it, and the Punch Glove and its 6-second cooldown are ability gameplay with no layout footprint, so they carry no option.
